DuplicateRule.alertText: Possible duplicate — an account with this phone number already exists. Check before saving. Naming standard: use the person's name only, e.g. "Amelia Martin", not "Amelia Martin Residence". The property goes in the address fields.
DuplicateRule.description: Ticket 2.2. Blocks creation of an Account whose phone already exists. Same phone is treated as high-confidence evidence of the same customer, so this one blocks. Edits are allowed with an alert so reps are not trapped mid-update on legacy records.
